arithmetic_review.consistency: The optimization_plan fields and all 44 panel production_plan records agree with these counts.

reframe_review.conditionality: Every target is a proposed future crop or reframe. No existing approved pixel asset is claimed, approval does not inherit from a master, and each target has an explicit fallback to a separately authorized new generation if actual pixels do not support the crop.

targets.support: The high-resolution vertical master explicitly requires Brahma to remain readable in a medium lotus-level crop; target and master share the Brahma-lotus location and the same instant.
targets.pixel_gate: Confirm exact Brahma identity, face and source-silent arm/head treatment at crop resolution.

targets.support: The master explicitly preserves an unoccupied still-water interval for the narrow danger crop; the target adds no character or later action.
targets.pixel_gate: Reject the crop if the water interval is too detailed for lettering or implies an invented island or attacker form.

targets.support: The master explicitly preserves a close crop of Brahma in gathered attention and a separate protected lettering field in the same invocation instant.
targets.pixel_gate: Confirm the crop excludes the distant figures without creating unsupported halo, weapon or multiplicity detail.

targets.support: The wide three-person boon-offer master keeps Vishnu fully readable for the quieter reaction hold while retaining both joint boon-givers.
targets.pixel_gate: Confirm all three required identities remain readable and the reframe does not invent motive or a victory ritual.

targets.support: The master specification deliberately keeps all three figures and unbroken flood visible beyond the tighter dialogue use, allowing the target to use the wider extent of the same high-resolution canvas after the words.

targets.support: The wide condition master explicitly keeps Madhu and Kaitabha jointly readable for the balanced two-shot crop, before any dry place or bodily solution is shown.
targets.pixel_gate: Confirm neither demon is lost, merged or replaced and the crop retains their joint condition rather than an outside boon-giver.

targets.support: The return-to-frame master explicitly retains sufficient fire-and-tree detail for the character-free closing crop in the same hermitage instant.
targets.pixel_gate: Confirm the close crop contains no residual figure fragment, new doctrinal symbol or next-book hook.

panels.assessment: Source-note back matter is text-led deterministic layout with a restrained forest-frame border, not a scene image or inherited character/location approval.
Editorial family reflection is text-led deterministic layout with fire-and-tree ornament only and no implied scriptural status.

layout_only_review.campaign_rule: Neither panel may become an image-generation unit. Their long editable text uses full-page back-matter layout; the image safe strip is not a claim that all back-matter text fits inside the strip.

safe_region_review.bounds_check: All 72 declared rectangles have positive area and remain inside normalized canvas bounds.
safe_region_review.production_condition: Prompted geometry is specification evidence, not pixel evidence. Every one of the 42 illustrated slots must be independently inspected for an actually empty, low-detail top region before lettering; dense pages 7, 9, 10, 11 and 16 require page-specific typesetting fit checks.

non_blocking_observations: The uniform safe rectangles are valid planning geometry but cannot guarantee that a generated image leaves them empty; actual-pixel review remains mandatory.

The p18-panel-02 wider reframe is acceptable only because the p18-panel-01 master specification explicitly asks the underlying high-resolution canvas to retain the surrounding flood; this is the most crop-sensitive of the seven targets.
Pages 7, 9, 10, 11 and 16 have relatively dense lettering and need page-specific fit checks after art placement; pages 23 and 24 instead use full-page editable back-matter layout.

PASS means the exact v2 planning records are coherent and ready to freeze into a new campaign. It does not mean the stale v1 campaign is usable, a provider is available, a spend is authorized, pixels exist or publication is ready.
